mission.name: Chaos at the windward mark (6 vessels)
mission.description: Six vessels converge on the same patch of water own-ship must pass through: five on assorted collision courses, each rounding and bearing away onto a new, unpredictable heading at its own staggered moment (never reactive to own-ship), plus one becalmed/dead-in-the-water vessel sitting in the middle of the convergence zone. Busier than IMP11 -- an extra near-astern contact means the 'safe' direction to bear away in keeps shifting. Correct: Rule 8 -- a single holistic plan re-checked as each vessel turns, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 6 contacts.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
